question: Which restaurants are located within 300 meters of the Belém Tower?
sql:
SELECT
    p.id,
    p.names.primary AS name,
    p.addresses AS address
FROM lisbon_places AS p
WHERE p.basic_category = 'restaurant'
  AND ST_Distance(
        ST_Transform(p.geometry, 3857),
        ST_Transform(ST_GeomFromText('POINT(-9.2157 38.6916)', 4326), 3857)
      ) <= 300;

question: Show all footways that touch any residential road.
Find all historic sites that lie completely inside the Alfama neighbourhood.
sql:
SELECT
    p.id,
    p.names.primary AS name,
    p.taxonomy.primary AS category
FROM lisbon_places AS p
WHERE p.taxonomy.primary = 'historic_site'
  AND ST_Within(
        p.geometry,
        ST_GeomFromText('POLYGON((-9.13 38.71, -9.12 38.71, -9.12 38.72, -9.13 38.72, -9.13 38.71))', 4326)
      );

question: Which road segments have a posted maximum speed over 50 km/h and intersect the Tagus River?
sql:
SELECT
    r.id,
    r.class,
    r.subclass,
    r.speed_limits[1].max_speed.value AS max_speed_kmh
FROM lisbon_roads AS r
WHERE r.speed_limits[1].max_speed.value > 50
  AND ST_Intersects(
        r.geometry,
        ST_GeomFromText('LINESTRING(-9.2 38.7, -9.1 38.8)', 4326)
      );

question: Which road segments pass through the location of Lisbon Airport?
sql:
SELECT
    r.id,
    r.class,
    r.subclass,
    ST_AsGeoJSON(r.geometry) AS geojson
FROM lisbon_roads AS r
WHERE ST_Intersects(
        r.geometry,
        ST_GeomFromText('POINT(-9.134167 38.774167)', 4326)
      );

question: List all road segments that are within 100 meters of any restaurant, together with their class and length in metres.
sql:
WITH restaurants AS (
    SELECT geometry FROM lisbon_places WHERE basic_category = 'restaurant'
)
SELECT
    r.id,
    r.class,
    r.subclass,
    ST_Length(ST_Transform(r.geometry, 3857)) AS length_m
FROM lisbon_roads AS r
WHERE EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM restaurants AS rest
    WHERE ST_Distance(
            ST_Transform(r.geometry, 3857),
            ST_Transform(rest.geometry, 3857)
          ) <= 100
);
